posts.title: Looking for a good VHF set
posts.text: Just took delivery of a new tractor. We do a fair bit of OS work and frequently require pilot/escort with us. Are there any VHF sets out there that you prefer and any to stay away from. Thanks submitted by /u/jjsprat38 to r/Truckers [link] [comments]
posts.author: /u/jjsprat38

drafts.no_link: Worth checking local dealers, auctions and Marketplace for a used one. We run YardSwaps, a marketplace for used work equipment from local owners and shops; it's early, so there may not be one near you yet. What size and budget are you after?
